summary: Bitterroot NF L-4 cab on a pole tower, built 1940, abandoned 1967, now listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a pole tower; pole height 15 feet or 20 feet (sources disagree)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1967. Firelookout.com says it was still there in 1974 but has since departed. Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list it as gone. No source describes the site now.

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts marks the lookout as hike-in on Bitterroot National Forest land. No source describes the route or current access.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per Idaho Fire Lookouts. No source describes the site now.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 15 feet on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; 20 feet on Rex's Fire Lookout Page. The story reports both. No height_m is recorded.

notes_for_editor: Three lookout-history pages agree on the 1940 build, the 1967 abandonment and the gone status, but none describes the site. The pole height conflicts (15 vs 20 feet) and is left open. Only one staffing season is documented (1961). Access is set to public from the national forest land and the hike-in label; no closure notice was found. Rex's page credits Ray Kresek's book, which was not checked directly.
